clips.title: The story
paras: Mountaineer Cobbleflint guards the southern tower in the Valley of Kings, desperately seeking aid against the encroaching Stonesplinter troggs. With Ironforge's military stretched thin across distant fronts, the defense of Loch Modan's southern passes falls to passing Alliance volunteers.

The massive dwarven monuments carved into the mountains of the Valley of Kings loom over a garrison under severe strain. Mountaineer Cobbleflint and his fellow guards stationed at the southern watchtower face an ever-growing invasion of troggs erupting from the rock. With much of King Magni Bronzebeard's regular army dispatched abroad to support Alliance commitments, the home front relies heavily on local patrols and hired blades to prevent the province from being overrun.

The subterranean threat originates within Stonesplinter Valley, a craggy ravine carving into the southern peaks of Loch Modan. Troggs and their scouts have burrowed surface-ward in massive numbers, carving out fortified camps along the valley floor. Left unchecked, their scouting parties threaten the critical roads connecting Loch Modan to the southern passes, forcing the Mountaineers to wage a continuous war of attrition.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We need to protect the Loch, friend! With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front. Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice! The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge. These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.
We need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat. Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Loch Modan is under siege, friend! We need every able-bodied member of the Alliance to aid our cause. Have you killed 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend! You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield. Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours. You have served King Magni well.

If you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw. The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with. Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
